items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played with John Patton, Baby Face Willette, a couple of guys.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I played with John Patton, Baby Face Willette, a couple of guys.
The records with John Patton are around 1960, with Baby Face Willette around 1961. I wanted you to tell us about the Jimmy Smith recordings just because the records are so great...
